title: Qenome record report (record_schema_version 1)
description: Stdout object after --record FILE --out DIR --format json. Separate from the batch report; see docs/json.md.

manifest.description: The manifest path that --out now holds.

records.description: Record lines read from the log, including the ones that were skipped.

queries.description: One object per manifest entry, in queries/qNNN.sql order.

skipped.description: Counters for the records that did not become a manifest entry or a shape.

writes.description: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and REPLACE records.

other.description: Statements that are neither read nor write.

unsupported.description: Records with a bind type that --bind cannot express.

nul.description: Records whose SQL or text bind holds a NUL byte.

large.description: Records whose SQL is larger than 1 MiB.

malformed.description: Record lines that are not a record_version 1 object.

repeated_shapes.description: At most 20 shapes, ordered by distinct_values, then executions, then first appearance.

repeated_shapes_dropped.description: How many shapes passed the threshold and did not fit in the top 20.

kind.description: read for SELECT and VALUES, write for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and REPLACE.

distinct_values.description: Distinct combinations of bind values and inlined literals. Records from op: batch are not counted here.

longest_run.description: Longest stretch of consecutive records with this shape in log order. A record that the report skips, such as a PRAGMA or an exec, ends the run.

statements.description: Distinct exact SQL texts with this shape; more than one shows inlined literals.

batched.description: Records with op: batch. They count in executions only.

example.description: One exact SQL text of the shape. Never a bind value.

previous_shape_example.description: The SQL of the shape that most often runs right before a run of this shape, which is likely the parent query. Null when no other shape came first.

manifest_select.description: The queries/qNNN.sql entry that holds a statement of this shape. Null for a shape that is not in the manifest.

hint.description: The fixed next step for the kind: one query with IN (...) or a JOIN, a multi-row INSERT, or db.batch().
